english.meaning: to move upward toward the speaker; to come up here
english.note: 請佢上來 means invite him to come up.

exampleSentences.english: We’re screwed, teacher. Just ask him to come up—no argument.
exampleSentences.traditional: 死晒嚹班主任。請問米請佢上來囖，冇得講𡃉。

exampleSentences.english: What’s good to eat in Shek Tong Tsui? But climbing back up after eating there is tough.
exampleSentences.traditional: 石塘咀有乜嘢好食呢？嘩，但係石塘咀食完䟴返上來，嗰下嘢辛苦。
